summary: 46 unit tests in tests/test_hw_review_cli.py covering all 5 subcommands, the validator (6 direct tests), argv smoke, plus 2 repo tests for set_preview_path. Total suite 324 green. Tests follow the tempfile-DB pattern from tests/test_integration.py:22-28. Mocks are limited to external boundaries: webbrowser.open, builtins.input, sys.stdin, Path.resolve (for the path-guard escape test), and update_staged (vanished-row test).

findings.finding: Every TDD-anchor item from tasks/7.md is represented, plus extras: test_skip_cancelled_on_eof (edge-case §9.13 п.5), test_preview_removes_old_file_on_rerun (idempotent re-preview §Risks), test_stage_accepts_empty_ru_paragraphs (§9.13 п.1), test_stage_reports_vanished_row (AC L63).

Only boundary mocks: webbrowser.open (external process), input (interactive), sys.stdin (byte stream), Path.resolve (escape-simulation), update_staged (vanished row race). No mocking of the SUT's own internals.
Negative-path tests assert both exit code AND stderr content AND (where relevant) absence of DB mutation. Happy-path tests verify persisted fields via repo.get_pending round-trip.
Each test gets its own tempfile DB; CACHE_DIR is patched to a tempdir per preview-test, cleaned up in tearDown.
